login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Your email and password, then the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.policy: Every account needs two-step sign-in. Sessions end after 15 minutes without activity.
login.codeHint: From your authenticator app. On a new account the setup key is shown here once.
login.mfaHint: The six digits your authenticator app shows right now.
login.enrolHint: Add this key to Google Authenticator, Authy or any authenticator app, then enter the six digits it shows. The key is shown only once.
login.tagline: The helpline that answers every farmer in under a second.

outbound.title: Outbound
outbound.subtitle: Farmers are called in the order you gave, as many at a time as you allow. Cards turn yellow while a call is on and green when it is done.
outbound.empty: No campaigns yet. Paste a list of numbers to start one.

newCampaign.title: New campaign
newCampaign.subtitle: Paste the numbers, choose what the agent says, and confirm the farmers agreed to be called.
newCampaign.noFlows: There is no published outbound script yet, so there is nothing for the agent to say.
newCampaign.explainChecks: Every number is checked before the first call: the do-not-call list, DND, consent, the calling window and duplicates. You will see exactly how many each check removed.
newCampaign.explainApproval: A second person approves the campaign before it starts. The person who created it cannot be the one who approves it.
newCampaign.explainOptOut: Every call opens with the legal disclosure, and pressing 9 removes a farmer from all future calls. Neither can be switched off.
newCampaign.name: Campaign name
newCampaign.flowHint: Only published outbound scripts can be used.
newCampaign.numbersHint: {count, plural, =0 {No numbers yet} one {# number} other {# numbers}} · one per line, as “number” or “name, number”
newCampaign.consent: These farmers have agreed to promotional calls from UA Agro (recorded at the centre or a meeting)
newCampaign.noteHint: Optional: where the consent was recorded, or anything a reviewer should know.

gate.invalidLines: {count, plural, one {# line could not be read} other {# lines could not be read}}
gate.needsAnotherApprover: Another ops manager has to approve it — you created it.

newCampaign.readNothing: No phone numbers were found in that file.

knowledge.subtitle: What the agent knows when a farmer calls the office number.
knowledge.empty: No documents yet. Add a price list, a crop guide or the website and the agent starts answering from it within minutes.
knowledge.deleteQuestion: The agent stops answering from it at once. To pause it instead, switch it off.

upload.drop: Drop a PDF, Word file, spreadsheet, text file here — or choose one
upload.dropHint: Ready to answer from within a few minutes. Prices and stock always come from the catalogue, never from a document.
upload.title: Title (optional)
upload.queued: “{title}” is being indexed — ready to answer from in a few minutes.

newScript.title: New script
newScript.explainer: Starts as a copy of the open script, under a new name. The legal opening and the opt-out line come with it.
newScript.name: Name

editor.explainer: What the agent says, in order. Edits are saved as a new version; nothing changes on the phones until you publish.
editor.publishQuestion: {type, select, outbound {Every outbound call from the next one onwards will use these words.} other {Every farmer who calls from now on will hear these words.}}

steps.lockedByLaw: required by law · cannot be changed
steps.askTimeHint: If they say no, the agent thanks them and ends the call. A busy farmer is called back the next day.
steps.messageHint: Change this to anything — an offer, a meeting invitation, a reminder. Use '{'नाम'}' and '{'केंद्र'}' to personalise. Numbers and dates are spoken in Hindi words automatically.
steps.key1: Wants the offer — say this, then send the WhatsApp message
steps.key2: Wants details — the agent answers from the knowledge base, then returns to the question
steps.key2Detail: Any question about crops, products, prices or the centre is answered from Inbound → Knowledge base. No dose or price is ever made up: if it is not in the knowledge base, the agent offers an agronomist call-back.
steps.key9: Do not call again — always on, cannot be switched off

inboundSteps.greetingKnown: Greeting for a farmer we know
inboundSteps.greetingKnownHint: Use '{'नाम'}' for the farmer's name and '{'केंद्र'}' for their nearest centre.
inboundSteps.greetingUnknownHint: Said when the number has never called before. The agent asks the name and the village next.
inboundSteps.closingHint: Said when the farmer has nothing more to ask.

preview.title: How it will sound
preview.explainer: Step {step}, as the voice will say it. Digits become words, dates are read the Indian way.
preview.empty: Type something in the step above and it appears here as the voice will say it.
preview.audioFailed: The voice is not available right now.

testCall.title: Test on my phone
testCall.explainer: The agent calls the number you give and runs this script as it is now, unsaved edits included.

data.title: Data
data.subtitle: Everything the agent and this panel keep, and where. Nothing here is edited by hand.

connection.title: Database
connection.note: The password is never shown here. The running connection is set by DATABASE_URL and a restart; this screen only tests one.

test.dsnHint: Tested once and forgotten: it is not stored or logged.
